title: Actively Resolving Contextual Uncertainty for Underspecified Tasks in Natural Language
description:
arXiv:2609.30428v1 Announce Type: new 
Abstract: Foundation models provide robots with the ability to interpret natural language and reason about environmental context, yet most language-conditioned policies assume that goals are well-specified and that task-relevant information is provided upfront via a prior map.
